scope: Frozen r2-snapshot only; completed 73 cases; unfinished PSY/SKL excluded
overall_role_verdict: Conditional research propositions are responsibly bounded; no major unsupported forecast found in sampled assertions. One minor terminology repair and two concrete negative-case tests.

propositions.assertion: Adverse outcomes for incumbents coexisted with employment recovery for later cohorts.
propositions.challenge: Recovery can imply a measured fall and subsequent rebound; original finding is later-cohort employment resilience, with heterogeneous adjustment and incumbent harms.
propositions.original_locator: QJE 139(3), p.1879 abstract; pp.1883–1884 introduction; p.1933 heterogeneity discussion
propositions.original_passage: did not reduce future cohorts’ overall employment
propositions.negative_case: Manufacturing-intensive cities and severe Depression demand contractions are less favourable adjustment environments.
propositions.verdict: Core distinction supported; minor wording refinement
propositions.action: Use resilience among studied later cohorts, keep sample scope visible, and test substitution demand rather than assuming retraining.
propositions.already_acknowledged: LBR dossier and claims preserve cohort scope, selective linkage and wage uncertainty.

propositions.assertion: Teaching, adaptation, demonstration and interpretation may matter when users apply capabilities.
propositions.challenge: Historical programme participation and competent preparation do not identify durable marginal demand for paid instruction.
propositions.original_locator: Health Policy and Planning 12(1), pp.58–59: abstract and programme description
propositions.original_passage: an intergenerational transfer of the knowledge on ORT
propositions.negative_case: Informal transmission and expanding packaged supply can change the remaining need for paid teaching.
propositions.verdict: Survives as conditional proposition; negative-case test recommended
propositions.action: Compare paid instruction with informal diffusion and product/access improvements; measure paid and unpaid time, funding and sustained use.
propositions.already_acknowledged: Candidate B already names free instruction, access constraints and interface alternatives; dossier does not claim randomized programme-component effects.

propositions.assertion: Coordination, dispute resolution and credible commitments may create value where participants cannot solve a problem alone.
propositions.challenge: A coordination bargain can protect incumbent claims through exclusions imposed on other workers; productive gain and access are distinct.
propositions.negative_case: PMA/ILWU arrangement reserved container work within fifty miles to longshoremen at PMA stations; the excluded firm employed Teamsters. The earlier compensation-fund financing also imposed contested unequal charges.
propositions.action: Evaluate incumbent members, excluded workers, entrants and payers separately; measure bargaining jurisdiction and benefit incidence, not only aggregate output.
propositions.already_acknowledged: Candidate C warns about rents, exclusion and nonchoosers; MOB claims distinguish judicial records from welfare measurement.
